steps.what: Check the biological specimen identity, existing chromosome images and analysis quality requirements
Arrange the observed chromosomes into a checked working karyogram for the analysis

loop.purpose: Propose chromosome segmentation and arrangement within the validated image-analysis workflow, not diagnose the specimen.
loop.input: Identity-checked chromosome images and existing laboratory image settings.
loop.output: Candidate segmented and arranged karyogram with original image references.
loop.check: Technologist checks every boundary, chromosome identity, orientation and arrangement against original images; difficult cells remain manual.
loop.stop: Poor image quality, uncertain separation or unsupported arrangement stops for manual karyogram construction.
loop.why_not_simpler: Image boundaries and chromosome appearance vary; fixed layout rules cannot classify the image. Use a validated native capability before custom work.

steps.what: Analyze chromosome findings and their limitations to support the appropriate diagnosis or treatment assessment
Write and save the actual chromosome analysis workpaper with image references and technical limitations

tasks.design: Use the laboratory's validated image-analysis system {OTHER} to propose a working karyogram, with every chromosome checked against the original images. Keep specimen checks, biological interpretation and the actual analysis workpaper human; no diagnostic result is released automatically.
tasks.previous_blocker: Arranging and separating chromosomes can require repeated manual image manipulation.
tasks.enabler_now: Validated image-classification assistance can propose arrangements, while retaining original image links and full correction.
tasks.still_hard: Poor morphology, complex findings and diagnostic significance require expert analysis.
tasks.human_edge: The technologist recognizes limitations and distinguishes a plausible arrangement from evidence-supported findings.

ambition.what: Support the same expert chromosome analysis with less repeated arrangement work.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: chromosome-image classification assistance can propose a karyogram, but every arrangement and its biological interpretation require qualified checking.

assumptions: {OTHER} means the existing laboratory information and validated cytogenetic image-analysis systems. Boundary is analysis of already prepared/acquired specimen images and the actual workpaper used for laboratory review, not specimen culture or formal diagnostic report release.

The actual upstream preparation/imaging workflow produces accession, specimen/cell/image IDs, acquisition settings and original images; that real work remains upstream and is unchanged, not free new capture. s1 counts this technologist's identity/quality checks and missing-image handling; s2 retains15 of30 units for all arrangement correction, and s3-s4 retain analysis and documentation in full.

Test the validated native image capability before custom code. Existing automatic segmentation/runtime earns no new saving; count only manual arrangement actually removed. Routine poor-cell repair remains in s2, additional validation/configuration and failed-assistance repair are upkeep below. Shares are unmeasured, not imported vendor percentages.

The workpaper is actually read for laboratory review. Ordinary same-system working saves in s4 are near-zero, fully retained and ungated without benefit. Intended use, clinical access, local validation and applicable device/consultation requirements need qualified assessment; no regulatory date or compliance determination is asserted.
unknowns: Existing validated assistance and real manual arrangement effort
Image quality and accepted intended use
research_questions: Compare actual manual arrangement effort on representative and difficult cells with complete technologist correction.
Test bad segmentation and specimen/image mismatch without accepting an analysis or releasing a result.

already_counted.description: Identity/quality checks, full arrangement correction, biological analysis and actual workpaper writing remain in s1-s4.

incremental.description: Maintain validated image settings, monitor local performance and repair failed assistance beyond retained case correction.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=20+15+40+10=85. Gross15 less3 upkeep gives12. Conservative case: poor morphology and overlapping chromosomes retain27 of30 arrangement units. Three gross units only cover upkeep; all analysis and source checks remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Select and quality-check the actual specimen cells and chromosome images for examination
Navigate the original chromosome views and comparisons needed to examine the selected cells
Examine chromosomes directly to detect abnormalities and assess uncertain or discordant findings
Document and save the actual chromosome examination findings with their source image references

tasks.design: Configure the existing cytogenetic viewer {OTHER} to keep linked original images and comparisons visible together. Retain cell selection, abnormality detection, uncertainty handling and all actual findings documentation with the technologist.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated image opening, panning and zoom synchronization can interrupt visual examination.
tasks.enabler_now: Native linked views can reduce those navigation actions without interpreting chromosomes.
tasks.still_hard: Subtle or complex findings and poor-quality cells demand expert examination.
tasks.human_edge: The technologist knows when visual evidence is insufficient and further examination is needed.

ambition.what: The same direct chromosome examination remains expert work.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: linked native image views can shorten navigation without detecting abnormalities or making an interpretation.

assumptions: {OTHER} is the current laboratory/image-viewing system. Boundary is examination of actual acquired images and the existing workpaper, not sample preparation or final report release. The actual imaging team produces accession, cell/image IDs and original files; upstream imaging is unchanged and not newly supplied free.

s1 counts identity, cell selection, quality and missing-source checks. Try native linked views first; s2 removes5 of20 repeated opening/pan/zoom units and retains15 for correct view selection and source checking. All actual detection and documentation remain in s3-s4. No model, new image capture or automatic classification is proposed.

Ordinary same-system workpaper saves in s4 stay near-zero, fully retained and ungated without gain; the workpaper is used for laboratory review. Configuration and broken-view repair beyond normal case navigation are upkeep below. Estimates are unmeasured and require local intended-use/access confirmation.
unknowns: Existing linked views and manual navigation
research_questions: Observe image navigation separately from direct abnormality examination.
Test inconsistent cell/image metadata and changed zoom without showing a misleading comparison.

already_counted.description: Cell/identity checks, source-view checking, all abnormality examination and workpaper writing remain in s1-s4.

incremental.description: Maintain validated linked-view settings and repair incompatible metadata beyond retained case navigation.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=25+15+45+10=95. Gross5 less2 upkeep gives3. Conservative case: incompatible cell/image metadata retain18 of20 navigation units. The2-unit gain only covers upkeep; detection, checks and writing remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Enter processing and analysis details in laboratory logs

steps.what: Capture and check the actual specimen processing actions, analysis details and technical issues at their source
outputs: checked source processing and issue details

steps.what: Input already recorded structured specimen and processing fields into the existing laboratory information log
inputs: checked source processing and issue details

steps.what: Write the actual analysis and technical-issue narrative required in the laboratory log
inputs: checked source processing and issue details

loop.purpose: Organize existing technologist notes into the current technical-issue log headings.
loop.input: Actual processing observations and existing issue notes with source references.
loop.output: Draft log narrative preserving chronology, uncertainty and unresolved issues.
loop.check: Technologist verifies every specimen reference, event, parameter, issue and corrective action against actual evidence; never infer a completed action.
loop.stop: Unclear specimen, unsupported event or ambiguous correction stops for manual writing.
loop.why_not_simpler: Only variable free-text issues need organization; structured fields use deterministic transfer.

steps.what: Verify the complete specimen processing and analysis log against sources and resolve missing or incorrect details
inputs: checked source processing and issue details

steps.what: Save the verified processing log in the same laboratory information system

tasks.design: Connect existing instrument/event fields to the working laboratory log {OTHER}, using exact specimen and event identifiers. A bounded draft handles only the actual technical-issue narrative; the technologist retains source capture, complete verification and unresolved-issue repair.
tasks.previous_blocker: Existing processing fields may be re-keyed into logs while varied technical issues need narrative entry.
tasks.enabler_now: Native instrument interfaces and source-linked field mappings can remove real duplicate entry; bounded drafting can organize issue notes.
tasks.still_hard: A missing action or technical event cannot be invented from an instrument timestamp.
tasks.human_edge: The technologist knows what occurred and distinguishes observed events from assumed completion.

ambition.what: Maintain the same actual processing log with less duplicate entry.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: existing instrument event fields can be mapped to laboratory logs, while actual manual actions and technical narratives need source capture and complete checking.

assumptions: {OTHER} means the current laboratory information system and instrument/event systems. Boundary is the explicit internal processing log used for traceability, not clinical report release. Ordinary working log field writes do not create a diagnosis or authorize an action.

The instrument already produces accession/event ID, instrument ID, event timestamp, recorded parameter/value/unit and event status where available. The technologist produces actual manual action, issue and correction observations in s1. s1 counts their real capture and checking; missing fields are not inferred. s2 transfers only fields that already exist, never free new capture.

Test native interfaces first. s2 represents real manual duplicate field entry only; existing imports and runtime earn no saving. s3 retains17.5 of25 units for working-note capture, meaning checks and correction; s4 retains14 units for full source reconciliation, manual missing-field entry and normal issue repair. Failed interfaces/drafts beyond those retained tasks are upkeep below.

s5 is ordinary same-system persistence at the minimum share, fully retained and ungated without saving. The actual log is read for laboratory traceability; no extra report or self-approval is added. Shares are unmeasured estimates; access, local validation and applicable consultation arrangements require confirmation.
unknowns: Actual duplicate entry and current instrument interfaces
research_questions: Trace each existing log field to its actual instrument or human producer.
Test an unmatched accession, duplicate event and failed transfer without marking an unobserved action complete.

already_counted.description: Actual source capture/checking, narrative correction, complete log reconciliation and ordinary persistence remain in s1, s3, s4 and s5.

incremental.description: Maintain event mappings and log headings, package actual issue sources and repair failed transfers/drafts beyond retained source checks.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=25+0+17.5+14+1=57.5. Gross42.5 less4 upkeep gives38.5. Conservative case: incompatible instrument event formats leave30 of35 field-entry units manual and ambiguous issue notes retain22 of25 narrative units. Eight gross units less4 upkeep gives4; actual source capture and reconciliation remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Assemble the actual verified test results, specimen identifiers and technical limitations for the report
inputs: existing specimen identifiers and technical limitations

steps.what: Summarize the actual test results in the existing report structure without adding diagnostic claims

loop.purpose: Organize actual verified findings and technical limitations into the existing summary headings.
loop.input: Verified result fields and technologist's existing notes with source references.
loop.output: Draft summary preserving exact result notation and stated uncertainty.
loop.check: Technologist checks every identifier, result, notation, limitation and interpretation statement against authoritative records; unsupported clinical meaning is removed.
loop.stop: Missing sources, changed notation or contradictory findings stop for manual summary writing.
loop.why_not_simpler: Only varied narrative requires organization; identifiers and exact result strings use native fields.

steps.what: Check the complete final test report and exact intended recipients against the verified result sources
Review the exact final test report under the laboratory's actual qualified report-release responsibility
Release the exact authorized test report in the laboratory system
Send the exact released test report to the authorized requesting professional or reporting authority
Save the test report copy in its existing laboratory working file

tasks.design: Assemble existing verified result fields in the laboratory system {OTHER}, draft only variable summary wording in {DOCS}, and retain full technologist and actual authorized reviewer checks. Formal release and real external delivery are distinct version-bound actions; the ordinary working copy save stays ungated and earns no saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: Result fields can be copied into reports manually, with repeated summary wording and delivery preparation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native result mappings, bounded summary drafting and secure delivery can reduce those operations without releasing unreviewed findings.
tasks.still_hard: Correct notation, limitations, clinical meaning and the proper reporting authority require qualified review.
tasks.human_edge: The technologist and authorized reviewer recognize misleading summaries and retain responsibility for the result and release.

ambition.what: Report the same verified findings with less duplicate assembly and summary composition.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: verified laboratory fields can populate reports and source-bound drafting can support summaries, while exact findings and release need qualified human review.

assumptions: {OTHER} means the existing laboratory information system and its secure report delivery. Boundary includes the actual summary, report release and delivery to the instructed authority; it does not create a new clinical interpretation or statutory recipient.

The real upstream validated analysis supplies accession/specimen ID, test/method, result notation, verification status, author/date and stated technical limitations. That actual analysis is unchanged upstream work, not newly obtained free input. s1 removes only current manual copying of existing verified fields; native result imports/runtime earn no gain. Missing results stop and are handled in retained s3 checks or additional connector repair.

Test native report templates and secure delivery first. s2 retains18 of30 units for current result-note capture, correction and semantic verification; s3 retains all29 final-source/recipient checks. Incremental packaging, failed-draft/interface/delivery repair is counted below. Shares are unmeasured estimates.

s4 represents the existing authorized qualified laboratory report-review role, not an invented supervisor; confirm the actual local authorization route. The final report and exact recipients exist before s4, which binds both formal release and delivery. Any changed result, limitation, recipient or route voids both authorizations. Reviewer time remains other-role effort, not a focal saving.

s5 is the actual formal result-release action, conservatively retained at minimum1 share without benefit, distinct from ordinary working persistence. s6 removes only real manual delivery preparation/transmission where it occurs today. s7 is near-zero ordinary same-system copy persistence, fully retained and ungated with no saving. No author approves her own note.
Local validation, intended use, access and applicable consultation requirements must be established; no legal compliance conclusion or current regulatory date is asserted.
unknowns: Actual manual report assembly and delivery
Verified result metadata and native report templates
research_questions: Trace actual verified fields into a final report and its real authorized delivery.
Test changed notation, missing limitation and wrong recipient; void both release and send authorization after any change.

already_counted.description: Actual result-note capture/correction, full technologist checks, tiny formal release and ordinary persistence remain in s2, s3, s5 and s7.
The actual qualified report review remains other-role effort, excluded from focal savings.

incremental.description: Maintain result/report/recipient mappings, package sources and repair failed imports, drafts or delivery beyond retained final checks.

approvals.approved_version: Exact final report and result notation authorized in s4; any changed content or release conditions void authorization.
Exact s4-authorized report content, designated recipient and secure delivery route; any change voids authorization.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Focal B=90; R=18+29+1+1=49. Gross45.5555 less5 upkeep gives40.5555, high rounded down to40.5. Reviewer time is excluded from B. Conservative case: incompatible result metadata retain23 of25 assembly units and complex limitations retain27 of30 summary units; only the actual4-unit delivery still automates. Nine/90*100=10 gross less6 upkeep for that difficult interface gives4. All qualified checks, release and persistence remain.

role.altitude: The technologist keeps specimen identity, image quality, chromosome interpretation and report responsibility. Actual duplicate data entry and bounded image/text preparation may take less time after local validation.
skills_to_grow: Check chromosome arrangements against original images
Trace every laboratory log field to its actual producer
Bind report release and delivery to exact authorized versions
role.ambitious_version: Maintain a traceable chain from original images and processing events to checked findings and the exact authorized report.
